description: Purpose: fetch one article record in full - title, publish date, author, account, topic category, source URL, confidence and an AI-readable summary. Guidelines: accepts the id from query_articles (rcb-art-xxx) or a title keyword; run query_articles first when the id is unknown; pair with get_announcements_timeline for a chronological view. Limits: metadata and summary only - the full article body is not served; one record per call. Ex: get_article(id='rcb-art-001'), get_article(name='曼谷大会').

name.description: 标题关键词（与 id 二选一），如 '曼谷大会'、'EPDM'

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读, json=Agent 处理友好

name: get_article

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
